title: Coyle Hall
description: Welcome to Coyle Hall, home of the Crew
content: Welcome to Coyle Hall, where truer words have never been spoken. Formerly known as Fisher Hall, our community now begins its new chapter under a new name, but make no mistake: the spirit remains the same. Home to generations of proud residents affectionately known as the Crew, this brotherhood has long been one of the most tight-knit, spirited, and iconic on campus.
